findings.highlight: Tohsaka makes a declaration of war
findings.evidenceJa: 何か八つ当たりじみた宣戦布告
findings.governingReading: 八つ当たりじみた describes the declaration as resembling taking frustration out on someone; it is Shirou’s impression, not a full statement of Rin’s motive.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s interpretation of Rin’s declaration as displaced frustration disappears.
